secrets.name: SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Flask session signing key. A development value was generated for this sandbox; set a long random value for any real deployment.

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Resend API key (https://resend.com/api-keys) used for welcome and notification emails. Without it the app runs normally but sends no email.

secrets.name: ADMIN_SETUP_CODE
secrets.description: Code required by /initialize-admin to create the first admin user. Sandbox placeholder 'dev-setup-code' lives in .env.base44-defaults; this value overrides it.

secrets.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.description: Extra password required for admin-only actions (clear logs, toggle another user's admin flag). Sandbox placeholder 'admin-dev-password' lives in .env.base44-defaults; this value overrides it.

secrets.name: MONGO_URI
secrets.description: MongoDB connection string. Defaults to the local compose 'mongo' service; set a hosted MongoDB URI (e.g. Atlas) to use an external database.
